subject: general
question: Ganesh Chaturthi is observed in ________ month of Hindu calendar.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bhadrapada**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In **Hinduism, Ganesh Chaturthi** is a** ten-day celebration **commemorating the** birth of the elephant-headed god Ganesha**, who is known as the knowledge and prosperity god.
 
• It starts on the fourth day, or chathurthi, of **Bhadrapada**, the **sixth month in the Hindu calendar**, which runs from **August to September.**
 
• Ganesha idols are set up on elevated platforms in houses or in ornately decorated outside tents before the beginning of the celebration.
 
• The 16 ways of offering tribute, or shhodashopachara, come first in the worship, after which is the pranapratishtha, a rite to bring life to the idols.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Bhadrapada** is the sixth month of the Hindu calendar, occurring in August and September, and is one of the four holy months of Chaturmas.
 
• **Kartika,** the eighth month of the Hindu calendar, is also the seventh month in India's national civil calendar, spanning from October 23 to November 21 in the Gregorian calendar.
 
• **Ashadha,** the fourth month of the Hindu calendar, aligns with June or July in the Gregorian calendar, starting from June 22 to July 22.
 
• **Vaishakh, **the second month of the Indian national calendar, corresponds to April or May in the Gregorian calendar.
